title: NotebookLM for Windows
subtitle: Native desktop wrapper for Google's NotebookLM
description: Power users of NotebookLM lose context every time they leave the browser. I shipped an Electron-based desktop wrapper with session persistence, system-level shortcuts, and native notifications for long-running audio generation tasks. The product converts a research-heavy web app into a persistent, OS-integrated workspace.

title: Snapdeal VIP
subtitle: Loyalty subscription programme
description: Owned the Snapdeal VIP loyalty programme end-to-end. Drove acquisition and retention through funnel analytics and behavioural cohorts. The first paid-loyalty motion at the brand.

title: Sterling OMS competitive intel
subtitle: B2B GTM acceleration at IBM
description: Built competitive analyses for strategic enterprise deals on IBM's Sterling Order Management team. Streamlined 1,200+ RFP questions into a reusable knowledge base — measurable lift in pre-sales velocity.

title: Pegasus spyware: a vulnerable behaviour-based attack system
subtitle: ICECAA 2023 · 10 citations
description: Co-authored analysis of Pegasus spyware attack vectors and behavioural vulnerability patterns. Most-cited of my published work. Looks at the human side of advanced state-grade malware — why people click, why systems trust.
